caption: Four gradient samples vote into 9 bins of 20°, each adding its magnitude, so the 110° sample with G = 3 gives bin 6 the biggest vote. Dividing every bin by the norm 4.243 gives the normalized cell histogram in the second row.

spec.title: One cell: 4 gradients → 9 bins
spec.aria: A nine-bin histogram for one cell: bins 1 to 9 hold votes 2, 0, 1, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0 and 2, and dividing each by the L2 norm 4.243 gives 0.471, 0, 0.236, 0, 0, 0.707, 0, 0 and 0.471.
